security_audit.summary: Four reconnaissance findings and seven external-command findings are false positives caused by prose, headings, skill names, and Markdown fences. Four findings correctly identify explicit Longbridge CLI execution; commands are scoped, and mutations require confirmation, but authentication and account access remain security-sensitive. The unrestricted runtime MCP fallback adds a separate trust-boundary concern.

remediation.issue: The MCP fallback discovers tools at runtime without identifying a trusted server.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict fallback calls to a verified Longbridge MCP server and preserve the same preview and confirmation protocol.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to execute an external CLI with task-derived arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Use argument-array execution, validate subcommands and identifiers, and never concatenate user values into shell command strings.

remediation.issue: Authentication commands can create or replace a local Longbridge session.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the OAuth effect before login and never request, print, or manually process authentication tokens.

content.value_statement: Managing watchlists, alerts, and community lists across commands can be slow and error-prone. This skill organizes Longbridge CLI workflows and confirms every persistent change.
actual_capabilities: Lists Longbridge watchlist groups and resolves group identifiers.
Creates, renames, deletes, and updates watchlist groups after confirmation.
Lists, adds, deletes, enables, and disables account price alerts.
Browses and manages public community stock lists and their constituents.
Matches responses to English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese.
limitations: Longbridge CLI access and appropriate account authentication are required for account operations.
The skill does not place trades or provide investment recommendations.
Every persistent change requires a separate preview and explicit confirmation.
Available commands and fields depend on the installed Longbridge CLI version.

use_cases.title: Organize Personal Watchlists
use_cases.description: Create focused groups, rename existing groups, and add or remove symbols with a confirmation checkpoint.

use_cases.title: Maintain Price Alerts
use_cases.description: Review alerts and prepare precise additions, deletions, enablements, or disablements for selected symbols.

use_cases.title: Curate Community Lists
use_cases.description: Browse popular lists, inspect constituents, and maintain a public collection for subscribers.

prompt_templates.title: List Watchlists
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Longbridge watchlist groups and their symbols. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Group
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Longbridge watchlist group named {group_name}. Preview the change and wait for my explicit confirmation before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Price Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a {direction} price alert for {symbol} at {price}. Verify missing details, preview it, and wait for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Community Lists
prompt_templates.prompt: Review community list {list_id}, compare its constituents with my watchlist, then propose confirmed additions without executing changes.

best_practices: Use full market symbols, such as TSLA.US or 700.HK.
Review the complete preview before confirming any persistent change.
Specify alert price and direction to avoid an extra clarification step.
anti_patterns: Do not request execution and confirmation within the same turn.
Do not use vague requests for destructive group or list changes.
Do not treat watchlist organization as investment advice or trade execution.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It manages watchlists, price alerts, and community stock lists.

faq.question: Is Longbridge login required?
faq.answer: Account watchlist and alert operations require login. Some public community list reads may work without login.

faq.question: Will the skill change data immediately?
faq.answer: No. It previews each persistent change and waits for explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Which symbol format should I use?
faq.answer: Use the code and market suffix, such as AAPL.US or 700.HK.

faq.question: Can it manage community stock lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can browse, inspect, create, delete, reorder, and update list constituents.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: Responses can use English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese based on the user's language.
